newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenyin & Wanguo tops in Shanghai bourse trading.
newsitem.headline: Shenyin & Wanguo tops in Shanghai bourse trading.

text.p: Shenyin & Wanguo Securities Co, China's largest stock brokerage, was the top trader on the Shanghai bourse in 1996, accounting for business worth 526.41 billion yuan, the Shanghai Securities News said on Tuesday.
The newspaper, quoting a report from the Shanghai Stock Exchange, said Beijing-based China Securities Co was the second-biggest trader in Shanghai in 1996, trading 334.167 billion yuan.

The Trust and Investment Co under the Construction Bank of China came in third on turnover of 179.758 billion yuan, followed by Fujian Industrial Securities Co, Shanghai-based Haitong Securities, Guangdong-based J & A Securities Co and Southern Securities Co, the newspaper said.
Shenyin & Wanguo Securities was established in April last year through a merger of the former Shanghai Shenyin Securities and the Shanghai International Securities (SIS).

The merger was coordinated by the Shanghai city government and the central securities authorities after SIS ran into deep debt following a state debt futures trading scandal in Shanghai in February 1995.
